high_level_description: This image is a collage of three photographs showcasing the Kakslauttanen Glass Igloos in Finland, a unique accommodation where guests can sleep under the stars and auroras. Top Left Photo: This photo shows an aerial view of several glass igloos nestled in a snowy landscape. The igloos are illuminated from within, creating a warm contrast against the cold, blue-toned snow. The surrounding area is dotted with trees, some of which are also covered in snow, enhancing the wintry atmosphere. The setting appears serene and remote, typical of a northern location.
